preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and all(0 <= val <= 10**12 for val in x)
preconditions.description: The list x contains exactly n non-negative integers, each not exceeding 10^12.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The edges form a connected undirected graph (a tree) with n vertices.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum of f(u, v) for all pairs (u, v) where u is an ancestor of v, modulo 10^9 + 7.
